metadata.title: Remap Toggle Switch to Filter Randomization/AM LFO

story.iWant: the toggle switch to enable or disable the existing filter randomization/AM LFO effect
story.soThat: I have direct control over when modulation is applied to my signal
story.tasks: - Locate existing modulation implementation - Connect B8 to modulation enable - Implement modulation gating logic - Add state persistence - Implement LED feedback - Audio glitch prevention - Testing and validation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Toggle switch (B8) controls existing filter randomization/AM LFO enable state 2. When enabled, existing modulation effect becomes active 3. When disabled, signal passes through without modulation 4. State persisted to QSPI (using existing persistence from Epic 1) 5. LED indicator reflects modulation state 6. Toggle state recovered correctly on power cycle 7. No audio glitches when toggling during playback

artifacts.code: - main.cpp:99-102 - Toggle switch processing - main.cpp:122-124 - Jitter/modulation control (CV_2) - main.cpp:27 - Jitter object declaration - main.cpp:41 - jitter_mix_level variable - main.cpp:48-58 - Settings struct for persistence - main.cpp:62 - SDSettings storage - main.cpp:76-83 - LED control functions
artifacts.dependencies: - Story 2.1 completion (toggle decoupled) - Epic 1 QSPI persistence - Existing jitter/modulation implementation - LED control infrastructure

story-context.constraints: - Must leverage existing modulation code - Must follow Epic 1 persistence patterns - Must not introduce audio glitches - Rate limit saves to 100ms minimum
story-context.interfaces: - Toggle switch hardware (B8) - Jitter modulation effect - Settings struct for persistence - LED output (hw.SetLed) - MIDI debug output

tests.standards: - Audio quality testing with spectrum analyzer - Smooth transitions without clicks/pops - Power cycle testing (10+ cycles)
tests.locations: - AudioCallback for modulation gating - Toggle handler for enable/disable - Settings save/load for persistence
tests.ideas: - Test modulation enable/disable - Rapid toggle scenarios - State persistence verification - LED state synchronization - Audio artifact detection
